730360102.text: Is that so? Sorry. But based on how you float, you shouldn't be exhausting any stamina.

730360103.text: Paimon must be fully focused to fly, so it is exhausting! Arama, just fly at the speed of a Seelie, alright?

730360104.text: A Seelie? In the ancient stories, Seelie were a great race with wisdom and beauty beyond the pale of this earth. They traveled with Nara and taught Nara languages and the philosophy of nature.

730360105.text: Huh? Paimon thought that they were just large but annoying fireflies that lead us around by the nose...

730360106.text: Seelie are just empty husks that race left behind. This is because they were born with a curse: If they fall in love with Nara, they shall lose their intelligence and strength, and their bodies will regress.

730360107.text: There was once a survivor of that race deep within the golden desert who was friends with Queen Aranyani and the ruler of Valuka. Perhaps there are more stories to be found in the eternal oasis.

730360112.text: Yes. So you see... at their prime, the Seelie were probably faster than a storm. Plus, isn't Paimon tired? We can rest while I tell stories about Sarva.

730360113.text: You even know how to be evasive now, Arama. You've really changed...

730360114.text: Anyway, this was our first home{RUBY#[S]Vanarana}land. Aranara used to live here before the disaster, and many Nara had visited us.

730360115.text: Before the disaster... Are you saying that...

730360116.text: Yes, and you've been to the second Vanarana. Meanwhile, Marana's Avatar is imprisoned by three seals deep within this place.

730360117.text: Three Inscriptions of Remembrance are needed to undo the first seal. While the landscape here is a little different from the memories I received, I have a rough idea where they are.

730360118.text: #Anyway, Marana is very dangerous. Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, I recommend we match each other's pace. Let me know when you're ready to set out.

730360119.text: Three seals, and we must find three Inscriptions of Remembrance just for the first seal... This is so troublesome. Why does everything have to be done three times?

730360120.text: They don't call it "The Rule of Three" for nothing...

730360121.text: Yeah... If Ruu were here, Paimon's sure he and Arama would become friends real quick...

730360123.text: Yes, he's a friend of ours.

730360124.text: #I see. I too wish to meet Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon's friend. A Nara who's friends with both of you is for sure a great Nara.

730360125.text: But it's alright. The past and the future meet in Sarva. A day will come when I'll have the honor of meeting this Ruu and becoming friends with him.

730360126.text: By the way, there are actually four seals imprisoning Marana. The first seal is the Door of Vana, which is right behind us.

730362101.text: (A slightly crude mural of Aranara with a golden Aranara among them. They seem to be happily celebrating something.)

subQuests.subQuestName: Go in search of the Inscriptions of Remembrance with Arama

730360301.text: Wh—What was that? Was that Ararakalari? It just...

730360302.text: No, it wasn't. Paimon needed help, so I hit the Marana very, very hard. I'm very pleased to say that I eliminated that evil tumor.

730360303.text: May we never meet again, evil tumor.

730360304.text: If hitting a Tumor of the Withering very, very hard can destroy it, the Aranara should be able to deal with The Withering once and for all, right?

730360305.text: No, it has to be hit very, very hard, specifically. Most Aranara aren't that strong.

730360306.text: Many, many suns must pass, then many, many moons must pass. When seed turns to tree, when stream turns to river, only then will an Aranara possess such strength.

730360307.text: Paimon gets it now. But y'know, you're speaking normally again, Arama...

730360308.text: Used too much strength just now. So, many words, many memories, gone with the wind.

730360309.text: Oh... Paimon remembers someone saying that memories are Aranara's bank of strength...

730360311.text: Paimon was just trying to eliminate The Withering here...

730360312.text: It's fine! Used energy will come back slowly. I've absorbed the Ashvattha Tree's memories, so I recover even faster. We destroyed Marana's evil tumor, very good, very good.

730360314.text: The seal is nearby. Many different Ararakalari here keep Marana's Avatar in. So, it sent the evil tumor to damage the seal.

730360315.text: That looks like Aradasha's stone lock...

730360316.text: And this... This is the flower that sealed Ashvattha's Concourse...

730360317.text: Oh! It's Arayama's flower. In the past, many Aranara fought Marana here, and together they sealed this place.

730360318.text: Marana's Avatar is very, very deep underground. Break this seal, then break the next seal, and we can face it and defeat it.

730360902.text: (Try to sense the memories within the inscription...)

730360903.text: ...Ah, so you too are a child of the forest. Since you're reading my Inscription of Remembrance, Marana is gone, right? Or perhaps you're here to put an end to it?

730360904.text: There are many stories I wish to hear. Is Araja's dream beautiful? Are Arana and Aramani doing well? I'm sure the new songs born into this world are absolutely beautiful!

730360905.text: Oh, there's no rush to tell me anything. For I hear no more and see no more. But fret not, for we shall meet in Sarva.

730360906.text: When the time comes, you can take your time to tell me the stories of the earth! This inscription is the work of Araji, Arayama, and myself — our pride and joy. It's yours now...

730360907.text: "May the new dre{RUBY#[S]Vanarana}ams never experience Marana's corrosion."\n"And may the old sto{RUBY#[S]Vanarana}ries be forgotten alongside it."

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue searching for the Inscriptions of Remembrance

730360401.text: Arama! We're back! How are you feeling?

730360402.text: Oh! I've built up some strength! I'm fine! I can sense that the seal is broken. Now, leave the rest to me.

730360403.text: There's so much sand here. I think it used to be stone and soil. But Marana took away the life and moisture in the soil, turning it into sand.

730360404.text: Aranakin hates sand. If only he could see this!

subQuests.subQuestName: Obtain the second Inscription of Remembrance

730361002.text: (Try to sense the memories within the inscription...)

730361003.text: Araji really wants to see Vanarana filled with many, many flowers again, and birds on green trees while Nara sing with us under the trees.

730361004.text: Marana really is terrifying, but thinking about scenes like that makes it less scary. Arayama said that Araji is very brave, and that Araji should think about happy things when afraid.

730361005.text: So Araji decided on the inscription's content, with the hopes that it will bring courage to you who have come to Vanarana that is beautiful no more...

730361006.text: "May the green fields and mountains never wither."\n"May the streams stay clear and the flowers remain in bloom."

subQuests.subQuestName: Continue searching for the Inscriptions of Remembrance

730360502.text: I see. But this place is very calm, very good.

730360503.text: Yeah. But it must be really difficult for you to keep the ring up and fend off The Withering, Arama...

730360504.text: #I'm fine! Being with Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon is a very happy thing. I won't forget!

730360505.text: I recovered some strength while resting, so I remember now! This used to be Aramuhukunda's home!

730360507.text: Whoa! Where did you come from...

730360510.text: ...Aren't you that mysterious Aranara we met during Festival Utsava? That Aranara who speaks unlike any other Aranara?

730360511.text: #You still remember. That gladdens me. Nara {NICKNAME} made a garland from my flower and the flowers of many Aranara. To me, that is a great honor.

730360513.text: You still remember. That gladdens me. You made a garland from my flower and the flowers of many Aranara. To me, that is a great honor.

subQuests.subQuestName: Obtain the third Inscription of Remembrance

730361102.text: (Try to sense the memories within the inscription...)

730361103.text: We will be victorious. The living will overcome the dead, and we'll meet again one day in Sarva.

730361104.text: "Friends will stroll through the forest again. That which is good will return, and the painful memories will vanish. Just like a stream purifying itself or a withered tree sprouting once more."

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the seal with Arama

730360614.text: Anyway, this is Old Vanarana, and it was the home of Aranara for hundreds of years before the disaster. We once hung out with Nara here.

730360615.text: Before the disaster... Are you saying that...

730360616.text: Yes, and you've been to the new Vanarana. Meanwhile, Marana's Avatar is imprisoned by three seals deep within this place.

730360618.text: #Anyway, Marana is very dangerous. Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, I recommend we match each other's pace. Let me know when you're ready to set out.

730361201.text: Is this the seal? What a huge tree hollow...

730361202.text: #Yes, it's all thanks to you that I've been able to witness Old Vanarana, and lay eyes on our original home. Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

730361203.text: ...Thank you, Aramaha, Araji, and Arayama, thank you for guarding the seal. Marana eventually managed to escape to the outside world, but it's not your fault.

730361204.text: Now, I shall undo the seal which has existed for hundreds and thousands of moons...

730361205.text: May the new drea{RUBY#[S]Vanarana}ms never experience Marana's corrosion, and may the old stor{RUBY#[S]Vanarana}ies be forgotten alongside it.

730361206.text: "May the new dreams never experience Marana's corruption, and may the old stories be forgotten alongside it."\n"May the green fields and mountains never wither. May the streams stay clear and the flowers remain in bloom."\n"Friends will stroll through the forest again. That which is good will return, and the painful memories will vanish. Just like a stream purifying itself or a withered tree sprouting once more."

730361207.text: The seal's been lifted! Is the path forward... downward?

730361208.text: Yeah, the second seal is up next. Let's go.

subQuests.subQuestName: Try to destroy the Tumor of the Withering

730361403.text: Aradasha is very strong. In the stories, a very, very long time ago, there was once a metal beast the size of a mountain, and it could spit fire like shooting light beams.

730361404.text: But Aradasha bested the beast and imprisoned it with a lock of stone! He saved many Aranara!

730361405.text: His legend was as dazzling as the sun, and many Aranara wished for their Ararakalari to be as powerful as his!

730361407.text: It was very scary! Even the sky turned black. Trees swayed like a field of grass under strong winds, and they all fell to the ground. And then very, very scary monsters were everywhere.

730361408.text: Many of the monsters in the memories I obtained look very much like the monsters we've seen. Like the black dogs, the huge metal beasts, and the hilinara.

730361409.text: Marana appeared during the disaster too, and many grasslands were turned to sand. That's why we fought Marana and sealed its avatar underground.

730361411.text: The seal was made by many Aranara. We... They wanted to imprison Marana and stop it from harming Aranara, Nara, and the earth.

730361412.text: Later on, Marana slowly seeped into the ground like water. But we were in the dreams already and unaware that it had turned out so terrifying...

730361414.text: #Alright! Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME}, and good luck!

730361601.text: Paimon never thought that there'd be such a deep space beneath the sands...

730361602.text: The earth is made of soil, stone, sand, and tree roots. So if sand is removed, a very, very large space will appear. Aranara, Nara, and animals can move within it.

730361603.text: But more sand should have vanished to make more space and let us go deeper. Bad sand.

730361604.text: Paimon saw many ruin machines while descending... So a fierce battle really did occur here...

730361605.text: Yes. The monsters here and the monsters in the Ashvattha Tree's dream, I've seen them in the memories too — the black dogs and huge metal beasts.

730361606.text: Let's look for a way to go further down!

subQuests.subQuestName: At least, it proves to be a way down

730361802.text: #Yeah! Paimon's fine! But {NICKNAME} always has it rough! Are you alright?

730361806.text: Paimon didn't expect to see a space like this here... Paimon doesn't sense The Withering either...

730361807.text: #This should be the final seal. Thank you, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, for coming here with me. Marana's Avatar should be close by now.

730361808.text: Once we defeat Marana's Avatar, I'll plant a new Ashvattha Tree, and then it'll produce the Bija for us.

730361809.text: Then let's finish this! We'll help Rana and complete Arana's request.

730361811.text: But I don't have enough memories. I don't know how to undo this seal...

730361812.text: Don't worry, it's not a big place. Paimon's certain we'll find something if we look around!

730361813.text: Arama, you rest and build up your strength! You'll need it if you plan to fight Marana's Avatar!

730362201.text: (A mural of many Aranara with their fronts — or backs — facing something strange. There's a golden Aranara with them.)

730361901.text: (This looks like a very ordinary chair.)

730361902.text: (...But both its size and workmanship clearly indicate that it's meant for humans, and not for Aranara.)

730362001.text: (It looks like something you'd see in an adventurer's camp. But the books are full of crooked drawings, mostly of Aranara doing something.)

730362002.text: (Speaking of which, why are adventurers so fond of bringing a stack of books with them when they go camping? Never mind the fact that their tents are open in all directions and block neither wind nor rain... Why must they bring a stack of books?)

730362701.text: (This seems to be the home of some Aranara, and looks just like those houses in Vanarana. But its "owner" is nowhere to be found.)

730362702.text: (If Aranara don't need to rest, why do they need houses?)

730362801.text: (Vines that have completely sealed the path off. There doesn't seem to be a way through.)

730362901.text: (Cool and clean water. It's impossible to tell where the water came from.)

730362401.text: (A mural of some Aranara forming a circle.)

730362501.text: (Four Aranara, one golden Aranara, and a column... Or is that a tree trunk? It's hard to tell since the drawing is rather vague.)

730362601.text: (A mural of three Aranara and a golden Aranara. They seem to be entering a huge whirlpool.)

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the deepest part of the cave

730360801.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, I recommend we match each other's pace. Let me know when you're ready to set out.

730360803.text: Yeah! Three seals... It feels like we have so much to do! Let's get moving!

730360808.text: Alright. We'll set out whenever you are ready.

730361701.text: Bad sand. Rough and coarse. Ugh, green grass won't grow from it.

730361702.text: There's a very, very huge Valuka outside the forest, and there are Nara in it. Nara must be suffering.

730362301.text: (A mural of many Aranara with their fronts — or backs — facing something strange. There's a golden Aranara with them...)

730362302.text: (No, there seems to be a change in the mural. There are two golden Aranara now.)

730363001.text: #If only Nara {NICKNAME} was here very, very long ago. Then you could have fought the huge metal beasts with Aramuhukunda, Aradasha, and the others!

730363003.text: #While Nara {NICKNAME} was fighting just now, I could sense that the huge metal beast was very bad. It absorbs Marana's strength and grows stronger.

730363004.text: #It would be exhausting for Nara {NICKNAME} if the battle went on. Then I remembered! In my memories, Aradasha used this Ararakalari to trap and destroy many huge metal beasts.

730363005.text: So, I tried his Ararakalari, and I hit it very, very hard.

730363007.text: I don't know. This place doesn't exist in the memories I received. It feels like the home of Aranara, but it shouldn't be like this...

730363008.text: But this place is very good. No Marana, and there's water, light, and grass.

730363010.text: Yes! This place is very good. We can rest.

730363201.text: ...I'm glad that you understand. Arama, help your friends, and let the new Ashvattha Tree become the anchor of Aranara's dreams once more.

730363202.text: I'll live up to your legacy. Aramuhukunda's name has filled us with courage since many, many moons ago, and that will not change for many, many moons to come.

730363203.text: We will defeat Marana's Avatar. With your memories, I hear everyone call out to you, and it fills me with more than just courage, with pride as well.

730363204.text: I believe in you. Like clouds know they have to release rain, the rain knows that it must fall onto the ground. Meeting all of you made me realize... that the time has finally come. I'm very happy.

730363205.text: Now, I can finally return to Sarva and meet Nara Varuna again.
